_readme: Never cite. Content farms, AI-summary sites, scraper directories, and any page that cites no source itself. Extend freely; removals need a DECISIONS.md entry.
note_on_the_last_two: Directories are fine for listing yourself (04 §3) but never as fact sources.
note_on_businessofapps: The /data pages are secondary aggregations; cite the original report they summarise.
